  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-starter/4.1.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the spring-boot-starter-4.1.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the spring-boot-starter-4.1.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[

  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.
